description: Load a Truepane project JSON file (from export_project or the web app's Export Project) into memory as a new project. Returns the project id and a summary. Screenshots embedded in the file are restored.

id.description: Project id to assign (auto-generated if omitted; replaces any existing project with this id)

path.description: Absolute path to the project JSON file

name: load_project
title: Load project JSON
